metadata.description: ONE Creative Agency's Claude Code plugins for the studio.

plugins.name: one-client-preview
plugins.description: Put client work online as private previews (websites, brand guides, dashboards, 3D): setup, new previews, send to staging, publish to the client link, passcode pages. How-to: https://claude.ai/artifact/HvFBWRbBwt2SjyZcAC7wvK

plugins.name: one-client-site
plugins.description: Build and run ONE client production websites (Astro + Sanity + Cloudflare): new site, build from the approved design, launch on the client's domain, updates after launch.

plugins.name: threejs
plugins.description: Current three.js knowledge for 3D work: scenes, materials, lighting, shaders, post-processing, React Three Fiber, glTF optimisation. From cloudai-x/threejs-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: one-image-compress
plugins.description: Compress a batch of images to Squoosh quality from a Google Drive folder, local folder or attachments: asks format, quality and size, never touches the originals, saves to a Compressed folder next to them.
